entities.summary: Revaz Lashkhi is a Georgian Greco-Roman wrestler, who competed at the 2012 Summer Olympics and won a silver medal in the men's Greco-Roman 60 kg category. He beat Sayed Abdelmoneim, then Zaur Kuramagomedov in the quarterfinal and Həsən Əliyev in the semi-final before losing to Omid Norouzi in the final.
